claims.text: Cover page reads: '03 January 2011 / ICOD 30 August 2010 / DIA-08-1101-023 / Defense Intelligence Reference Document / Defense Futures / Negative Mass Propulsion'.

a.label: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)

edges.label: produced under the AAWSA/AAWSAP contract, FY 2010
edges.note: The released document names the programme itself. Its inside cover reads 'This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency ... Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program' - the redaction between them is (b)(3):10 USC 424. Verified by downloading this DIRD and scanning its full text on 23 August 2026. The scans are OCR-degraded, so the quotation is normalised from the damaged rendering.

edges.label: published, numbered and released by DIA as DIA-08-1101-023
edges.note: DIA commissioned, holds and released this document. It carries a DIA document number in the DIA-08-xxxx-xxx series on its cover and was released through the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room, whose FileId entry is cited here alongside the retrievable copy. Cover page read on 22 August 2026.

b.label: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)

edges.label: commissioned subject-matter author
edges.note: Credited with two of the 38 AAWSAP deliverables: 'Advanced Nuclear Propulsion for Manned Deep Space Missions' (11 March 2010) and 'Negative Mass Propulsion' (3 January 2011, DIA-08-1101-023). Both released texts name AAWSAP. The work was contracted through the DIA/BAASS chain, not performed as a DIA employee. Tier 2: both documents have their 'Author' field redacted under FOIA exemption (b)(6), so the attribution rests on DIA's separate list of deliverables.

b.label: Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies (BAASS), LLC

edges.label: commissioned via the BAASS prime contract
edges.note: Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies held the DIA contract under which the DIRDs were produced and subcontracted the individual authors; the DIA cover letter to SASC describes the list as 'all products produced under the AATIP contract'. Tier 2 rather than tier 1 because the contractor name is redacted under (b)(3):10 USC 424 on the DIRD cover page itself, so the subcontracting chain for this specific paper is inferred from the programme structure rather than read off the document.

edges.label: authored by
edges.note: The DIA congressional list credits 'Negative Mass Propulsion' to 'Dr F Winterberg, Univ of Nevada-Reno'. Winterberg is also credited on the same list with 'Advanced Nuclear Propulsion for Manned Deep Space Missions', and published related negative-mass propulsion work in the Journal of the British Interplanetary Society in 2011.

edges.label: series member
edges.note: Membership of the DIRD series is established by the released document itself: its cover page carries the Defense Intelligence Reference Document mark and the DIA Defense Futures banner. Document number DIA-08-1101-023. Publication date 03 January 2011 on the cover. 44 pages in the released copy. The cover of the scanned release is degraded, so a document number or date is asserted here only where it reads unambiguously.
